hints: Use $\tan(A\pm B)=\frac{\tan A\pm\tan B}{1\mp\tan A\tan B}$ with $\tan45^\circ=1$.
Let $t=\tan\theta$, clear the two denominators, and collect terms to form the required quadratic in $t$.
Solve the quadratic for the two values of $\tan\theta$.
For each tangent value, find every $\theta$ in $0^\circ\leq\theta\leq180^\circ$.
walkthrough:
Apply the compound angle formulas for tangent with $\tan 45^\circ = 1$:
$$\tan(\theta + 45^\circ) = \dfrac{\tan\theta + \tan 45^\circ}{1 - \tan\theta\tan 45^\circ} = \dfrac{\tan\theta + 1}{1 - \tan\theta}$$
$$\tan(\theta - 45^\circ) = \dfrac{\tan\theta - \tan 45^\circ}{1 + \tan\theta\tan 45^\circ} = \dfrac{\tan\theta - 1}{1 + \tan\theta}$$

Let $t = \tan\theta$ and substitute into the given equation $\tan(\theta + 45^\circ) - 2\tan(\theta - 45^\circ) = 4$:
$$\dfrac{t + 1}{1 - t} - 2\left(\dfrac{t - 1}{1 + t}\right) = 4$$

Multiply the entire equation by the common denominator $(1 - t)(1 + t) = 1 - t^2$ to clear fractions:
$$(t + 1)(1 + t) - 2(t - 1)(1 - t) = 4(1 - t)(1 + t)$$

Combine terms on the left-hand side:
$$(t^2 + 2t + 1) + (2t^2 - 4t + 2) = 3t^2 - 2t + 3$$

Set equal to the right-hand side and collect all terms on one side to form the quadratic equation:
$$3t^2 - 2t + 3 = 4 - 4t^2$$
$$3t^2 + 4t^2 - 2t + 3 - 4 = 0$$
$$7t^2 - 2t - 1 = 0$$
$$7\tan^2\theta - 2\tan\theta - 1 = 0$$

Solve the quadratic equation using the quadratic formula with $a = 7$, $b = -2$, $c = -1$:
$$t = \dfrac{-(-2) \pm \sqrt{(-2)^2 - 4(7)(-1)}}{2(7)} = \dfrac{2 \pm \sqrt{4 + 28}}{14} = \dfrac{2 \pm \sqrt{32}}{14} = \dfrac{2 \pm 4\sqrt{2}}{14} = \dfrac{1 \pm 2\sqrt{2}}{7}$$

Find the solutions for $\theta$ in the interval $0^\circ \leq \theta \leq 180^\circ$:
For $\tan\theta = 0.546918$ (first quadrant):
$$\theta_1 = \arctan(0.546918) \approx 28.676^\circ \approx 28.7^\circ$$
For $\tan\theta = -0.261204$ (second quadrant):
$$\theta_2 = 180^\circ - \arctan(0.261204) \approx 180^\circ - 14.639^\circ = 165.361^\circ \approx 165.4^\circ$$

State the two angles correct to 1 decimal place:
$$\theta = 28.7^\circ \quad \text{or} \quad \theta = 165.4^\circ$$
